answer: Require every agent identity to earn a non-transferable reputation stake through sustained, verifiable work before it can transact at full weight. Think of each new identity as an inlet: it enters through a narrow channel with tiny limits, and only checked tasks widen it. Each success raises standing a little, failures reset progress, so a trusted agent reaches the wharf slowly. A sybil farmer is trapped in a spiral: every fake identity must repeat the same slow, costly climb, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand times the time and compute, while one honest agent pays it only once.
